description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Developer 
  
 About the Role 
  
 Conduent is seeking a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Senior Developer to inspire and lead technical teams to build cutting-edge solutions and proactively bring new ideas, technologies, and methodologies to the table.    
  
 Responsibilities   
  
 Designed, developed, and customized Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) applications to meet complex business requirements across Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, Field Service, and Project Service modules. 

 Developed custom Plug-ins, Custom Workflow Activities, Custom APIs, JavaScript, HTML Web Resources, Business Rules, Ribbon Customizations, and Command Bar extensions using C# and .NET. 

 Built and customized Model-Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, Power Pages, and Custom Pages using Microsoft Power Platform. 

 Developed reusable Power Automate flows to automate business processes, approvals, notifications, and integrations with external systems. 

 Implemented PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) controls to enhance user experience and extend Dynamics 365 functionality. 

 Designed and implemented integrations between Dynamics 365 CE and external applications using REST APIs, Web API, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure API Management, and Custom APIs. 

 Developed Azure-based integration services to support real-time and asynchronous communication between enterprise applications. 

 Created and maintained Dataverse tables, relationships, security roles, business process flows, and system configurations. 

 Customized forms, views, dashboards, site maps, and security models to improve usability and support business operations. 

 Configured and implemented Omnichannel for Customer Service, Unified Routing, and customer engagement solutions. 

 Integrated Genesys Cloud and other third-party applications with Dynamics 365 to enable omnichannel customer interactions. 

 Implemented AI-powered capabilities using Microsoft Copilot, Power Virtual Agents, and Azure AI to improve productivity, automate customer interactions, and enhance user experience. 

 Developed and consumed Custom APIs, Web APIs, and external services for seamless enterprise integrations. 

 Created SSRS reports and FetchXML reports to support operational and business reporting requirements. 

 Managed solution deployments, version control, and release activities using Azure DevOps and Power Platform Pipelines. 

 Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. 

 Analyzed business requirements and prepared technical design documents, effort estimates, and implementation plans. 

 Developed proof-of-concept (POC) solutions to evaluate new Microsoft technologies, Power Platform features, and AI capabilities. 

 Performed code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and production support while ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices. 

 Investigated and resolved production issues by performing root cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions. 

 Optimized application performance through efficient plugin design, query optimization, and best practices for Dataverse development. 

 Collaborated with business analysts, QA teams, solution architects, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-quality CRM solutions. 

 Mentored junior developers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and sharing Dynamics 365 and Power Platform best practices. 

 Prepared technical documentation, deployment guides, knowledge transfer documents, and support documentation for ongoing maintenance and future enhancements. 

  
 Requirements   
  
 Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in Dynamics 365 CE CRM plus Power platform CoE experience with strong technical and client facing skills 

 Dynamics 365 Customer Service experience is a must and the knowledge other Microsoft Dynamics 365 suite of products 

 Experience setting up Power platform and Power pages. 

 Facilitate detailed design from requirements and support construction and deployment 

 Design components in a Service Oriented Architecture SOA environment with good technical expertise in middleware tools. 

 Providing highly available scalable Dynamics 365 architecture 

 Hands on experience in CNet Java Script MS SQL MS CRM SDK MSD developer toolkit SSRS 

 Subject matter knowledge in integration architecture and the ability to map integration pattern to functional usage 

 Experience in MS CRM 3rd party Integration using Middleware Tools APIs REST WebAPIs SSIS packages 

 Experience in using Azure services for integration. Azure Functions Service Bus etc.  Power Apps and Power Automate for upstream downstream systems integrations. 

 Experience in data migration data analysis data mappings data harmonization using OOB and third-party tools preferable experience in Azure Data Factory. 

 Experienced in reporting architecture with SSRS and knowledge on Power BI 

 Good to have knowledge in latest features of Dynamics 365 Customer Service Insights Customer Voice etc. 

 Experience in effective management of cloud platform resources and good understanding of security models and connectivity CRM systems 

 Technical expertise in setting up DevOps pipelines for CRM systems on cloud platforms with standard DevOps tools 

 Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent work experience. Masters Degree preferred.  

  
 Flexible Working   
  
 At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.     
 In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:  
  
 Tethered work: Enjoy the convenience of working from home while living within an easy travel distance to the Conduent location where the work is being performed (distance varies based on location and job). 

  
 Working For You   
  
 Perks and rewards designed for you:  
  
 Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.  

 Great Work Environment: We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.  

  
 Join Us   
  
 At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can:     
     
 Bring your authentic self to work     
 Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally     
 Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support     
     
 When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!  
   
  
  
  
 Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information.  For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $80,080 - $104,000. 
  



 Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
